title: Fighter jet scrambled and possibly fired on the 1952 DC lights

tellings.quote: of discussion that actually there were some I think it was an f105 U fighter jet that was actually scrambled to intercept those lights those luminous objects and there's even one report reported account where perhaps uh they were asked to fire upon and may have actually hit one of them

plain: During the 1952 wave of glowing lights seen over Washington, DC, a fighter jet, which he thinks was an F-105, was sent up to intercept the luminous objects, and by one account the pilot was asked to fire on them and may have hit one. Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official, tells this on the show as something he has heard discussed, not something he saw. If true, it would mean the military shot at an unknown object over the capital.
